'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Justin Desai LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title The only LS Deck capable of going 4-0. Line 1 Peace and Justice struck → published [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]] from senate package. Tendra Risant → [[Tendau Bendon]]. Someone must impress me → [[Impressive, Most Impressive (V)]]. I'm Attending (V) published as written (may redlink). Gravity of Circumstance → [[The Gravest Of Circumstances]].
